description: You are a building energy manager commissioning a net metering monitoring system. The building's grid-tied smart meter has been connected and posts import and export power readings in Watts every 10 seconds to Emoncms at http://localhost (admin/admin) under node 'smartmeter' (inputs: import_w and export_w). The meter's documentation specifies a calibration correction factor of 1.15 that must be applied to import_w readings before logging (to align with the utility billing meter). Set up the complete net metering pipeline: configure import_w with a process list that applies the 1.15 calibration multiplier, logs to a named 'Grid Import Power' feed, and accumulates energy in a 'Grid Import Energy kWh' feed. Configure export_w to log to a 'Grid Export Power' feed and accumulate energy in a 'Grid Export Energy kWh' feed. Build a dashboard named 'Grid Energy Monitor' with at least 4 widgets showing import power, export power, import energy, and export energy.
